items.title: Stryker completes acquisition of ZuriMED and adds the FiberLocker rotator cuff system to Sports Medicine
items.summary: Stryker announced on 26/10/2026 that it has completed its acquisition of ZuriMED, a privately held Zurich company. The FiberLocker System, a rotator cuff augmentation technology, joins Stryker's Sports Medicine portfolio.

items.title: Case study: Shaun’s journey through eight joint surgeries
items.summary: After eight operations on both his hips and shoulders in more than a decade of treatment, Shaun’s journey has been anything but straightforward. Living with complex osteoarthiritis has meant years of hospital appointments, surgeries and rehabilitation.

items.title: Zimmer submits Monogram autonomous orthopaedic robot to FDA
items.summary: Zimmer Biomet has filed a 510(k) for the Monogram autonomous orthopaedic robot, which uses CT imaging unlike its existing Rosa system. The company is targeting FDA clearance and a 2027 launch, a year ahead of its earlier 2028 plan. Zimmer bought Monogram in 2025 for $177 million.

items.title: STFC software shows how spinal discs respond to pressure
items.summary: STFC Scientific Computing tools turned 3D X-ray images into measurements of how collagen fibres in spinal discs move under load, in Queen Mary University of London and UCL research published in Nature. The work may help explain why discs deteriorate with age.

items.title: Rib fracture repair systems: Advancing the future of surgical trauma care
items.summary: The global rib fracture repair systems market was valued at USD 326 million in 2025.

items.title: LEDA Orthopaedics secures minority investment from LDC to fund NHS distribution expansion
items.summary: Cambridgeshire-based orthopaedic distributor LEDA Orthopaedics has taken a minority investment from LDC, part of Lloyds Banking Group, to expand into new markets and broaden its specialist upper-extremity product range across NHS trusts and private hospitals.

items.title: Workforce warning over Scottish orthopaedic overhaul
items.summary: Union leaders are warning that plans to centralise Scottish orthopaedic services without a detailed workforce plan to back up the move risk leaving local hospitals understaffed, putting patients at risk.

items.title: The next role for AI in orthopaedics is outside the operating theatre
items.summary: The conversation about artificial intelligence in orthopaedics usually begins close to the operating theatre. Imaging, surgical planning and robotics naturally attract attention because their connection to treatment is easy to see.

items.title: Smith+Nephew confirms talks with Johnson & Johnson over DePuy Synthes have ended and cuts its 2026 outlook
items.summary: In its third-quarter update on 04/11/2026, Smith+Nephew said it approached Johnson & Johnson earlier in the year about a possible combination with DePuy Synthes, that discussions took place and have now ended. Its Board will keep exploring strategic options for the Orthopaedics business.

items.title: Europe’s first robotic-assisted hip replacement performed using next-generation Mako technology at The Princess Grace Hospital
items.summary: HCA Healthcare UK’s The Princess Grace Hospital has become the first hospital in Europe to perform a robotic-assisted hip replacement using Total Hip with Advanced Primary and Revision software on the hospital’s newly acquired Mako robotic system.
